reviews.body: Tried this against a local dev server with 1.25.0 plus this change. One case breaks, inline.

review_comments.body:
With this change `maxConcurrentWorkflowTaskPolls: 1` reaches Core as `simple-maximum` 1, and `Worker.create` now fails while the sticky cache is on (the default):

```
`max_cached_workflows` > 0 requires `workflow_task_poller_behavior` to be at least 2
```

Before, the value was ignored, so the same config started. The `nonStickyToStickyPollRatio` doc also says 1 works ("there will be 2 concurrent polls"). Should this clamp to 2 when `maxCachedWorkflows > 0`, or reject 1 with a clearer error and fix that doc?
